fromContent: Jupiter is the most massive planet in the solar system, more than twice the mass of all the others combined.
toContent: Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a giant anticyclonic storm, larger than Earth, that has persisted for centuries.

fromContent: Red blood cells carry oxygen from the lungs to the body's tissues using haemoglobin.
toContent: White blood cells defend the body against infection as part of the immune system.
subtype: co-occurrence — two blood-cell types, embedding-near, independent roles

fromContent: A stack is a last-in-first-out (LIFO) data structure: the most recently pushed item is the first popped.
toContent: A queue is a first-in-first-out (FIFO) data structure: the earliest enqueued item is the first dequeued.
subtype: co-occurrence — sibling data structures, often compared, neither derives from the other

fromContent: Like electric charges repel each other and opposite charges attract.
toContent: The SI unit of electric charge is the coulomb, defined via the ampere as one ampere-second.
subtype: co-occurrence — two facts about electric charge, independent
